scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.share: concurrently "npm run dev" "npx --yes ngrok http 5173 --log=stdout" "node scripts/get-ngrok-url.js"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start:prod: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
